title: Nothing is deleted; deprecated nodes are superseded
context: Alternative approaches: support deletion; archive old versions; use soft deletes elsewhere in the codebase.
decision: Nothing in Schematify is ever deleted. A node with an inbound edge cannot be deleted. Such a node moves to `deprecated` and carries `superseded_by` set to its replacement. This rule applies to nodes, edges, rules, screens, flows, decisions, and registry entries. On a dangling reference, Schematify quarantines the referring node and reports the reference.
consequences: Full historical traceability and audit trail; no data loss; dangling references are detected and reported; dependencies become explicit through the supersession chain; the `deprecated` state is visually distinct and prevents accidental use.
